caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers supported by six ornate, turned legs connected by carved stretchers. The chest has two smaller drawers at the top, followed by three larger drawers arranged vertically, and a longer horizontal panel with two small drawers beneath, separated by decorative woodwork. Each drawer features elaborate metallic handles or escutcheons in a light, possibly brass or silver color. The main body and legs of the chest are a dark brown wood, while the drawer fronts have a textured, lighter brown or tan veneer. The top of the chest has a broad, prominently molded cornice. The entire composition is centered on a plain, light beige background with a single-line border framing the piece. The name "ISADORE GOLDBERG" is written at the bottom left corner of the paper.
title: Highboy
